pages.en:
Richard T. Evans
Attorney at Law.
1 Victoria Terrace, Tientsin.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C.I.D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 826.
Date 13 - 2 - 30.）

February 4, 1930.

R.T. Bryan, Jr.,
Police Advocate,
Shanghai Municipal Council
Shanghai.

Regy:
Copy this and
return to P.A.
keep stamps for
postal use.
K.C.A.

Dear Mr. Bryan,

Re: Kapoostin case

It was found that the man by the name of M.Kokovin
in Shanghai is not the man we seek, not even a relative of his.
We now hear that Mr. Kokovin is in Japan. This is his address:
M.M. Kokovin, The Little Shop, 60 Shimoya mate Dori, I-choma
(Ykutame) Kobe Japan. I am arranging to have a request sent by
the Execution Department to the Japanese Consul in Tientsin to
have this man arrested in Japan.

I am sending you stamps to cover the cost of your
telegram amounting to $3.60.

Yours faithfully,
sd.

Enclosure
A/D.C.I.
R.T.E:L.C.
These stamps evidently are for you
Kindly return the letter.
sd. R.T.B.

Original returned 6 P.M.
after 1 D.C.I.
13.2.30.

1930年2月4日。

R.T. 布莱恩  Jr.，
警务检察官，
上海公共租界工部局
上海。

登记室注：
将此件复印并
退回警务检察官。
保留邮票供
邮资使用。
K.C.A.

亲爱的布莱恩先生：

关于：卡普斯京案

经查，在上海名为 M. Kokovin 之人并非我们要找的人，甚至不是其亲属。
现获悉 Kokovin 先生在日本。其地址如下：
M.M. Kokovin, The Little Shop, 60 Shimoya mate Dori, I-choma
(Ykutame) Kobe Japan（日本神户）。我正安排由执行科向天津日本领事馆发出请求，以便在日本逮捕此人。

现寄上邮票，以支付您电报费用共计3.60美元。

此致
敬礼，
签名。

附件
助理刑事侦缉处长
R.T.E:L.C.
这些邮票显然是给您的
请将信退回。
签名 R.T.B.

原件于下午6时退回
经副刑事侦缉处长阅后
30.2.13。

No. I. O. D. 826.
Date: January 3rd, 1930.
3 / 1 / 30.

Subject (in full) Cable from Tientsin re Michael Kokovin.

Made by ______ and ______ Forwarded by ______ Det: Supt: Conduit.

Sir :
Michael Kokvin has resided in the International Settlement since 1920 at No. 4 Kungping Road. He and a brother named Stephen have had a stall in Hongkew Market since 1920. No brother by the name of Fedor.
About 7 days ago ex-D.S. Kedrolivansky was making enquiries at Hongkew Market re Michael Kokovin.

Yours obediently,
L. Conduit.
Div: Det: Officer,
"D" Division.

O. C.
(C.B.).

Enquiries were made by
Ex D.S. Kedrolivansky in
accordance with requests
received by telegram from
A. P. Samokhoff, Inspector,
British Police, Tientsin.

7/1/'30.

先生：
米哈伊尔·科科温自1920年起居住于公共租界公平路4号。他和一名叫斯蒂芬的兄弟自1920年起在虹口市场拥有一个摊位。没有名叫费奥多尔的兄弟。
大约7天前，前侦探警佐凯德罗利万斯基曾在虹口市场就米哈伊尔·科科温一事进行调查。
